title: Air Suspension Bellows Replacement: Sequence & Safety
description: Intermediate technical English module analyzing air suspension bellows replacement: sequence & safety.
learning_objectives: Master professional Prepositions of Cause & Manner in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in air suspension bellows replacement: sequence & safety
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: Before loosening the lower air bellows retaining flange, the technician _____ the pneumatic suspension system to prevent explosive decompression.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is directly followed by the bare infinitive verb 'depressurize' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal verbs never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'must' cannot be followed by an '-ing' participle.
explanations.wrong_D: 'is must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: V angličtině se po způsobovém slovesu 'must' klade holý infinitiv bez 'to': 'must depressurize' (nikdy *must to*).

questions.prompt: Workshop safety protocol mandates that heavy-duty mechanical axle stands _____ securely beneath the backbone tube crossmember before anyone enters the pit.

explanations.correct: The mandative subjunctive or passive construction following 'mandates that' requires 'be positioned'.
explanations.wrong_A: Active continuous 'are positioning' does not fit passive axle stands.
explanations.wrong_B: Axle stands do not position themselves actively.
explanations.wrong_D: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Pasivní vazba u bezpečnostních předpisů: stojany musí být umístěny ('be positioned'). Neživé předměty nejednají aktivně.

questions.prompt: The mechanic noticed an audible hiss around the auxiliary air valve _____ the bellow bladder was being inflated to operating height.

explanations.correct: 'While' is a conjunction followed by a full continuous clause ('the bellow bladder was being inflated').
explanations.wrong_B: 'During' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.
explanations.wrong_C: 'For' indicates duration of time, not concurrent background actions.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Since' indicates a starting point in time or causation, not simultaneous events.

questions.cz_learning_point: Častá chyba: 'during' se pojí s podstatným jménem (during the test), zatímco s celou větou se slovesem se pojí spojka 'while' (while it was being inflated).

questions.prompt: After removing the top mounting bolts, inspect the upper vulcanized rubber bead _____ signs of ozone cracking or abrasive wear against the bump stop.

explanations.correct: The standard engineering collocation is 'inspect [something] for [defects/signs]'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'inspect to' is incorrect phrasing for checking defects.
explanations.wrong_B: 'inspect at' is non-standard in mechanical inspection.
explanations.wrong_C: 'against' expresses opposition or contact, not the purpose of the inspection.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'inspect for defects' = zkontrolovat na přítomnost vad. Češi často nesprávně volí předložku 'on' nebo 'at'.

questions.prompt: If the replacement bellows does not seat properly on the lower swinging half-axle pedestal, the air fitting _____ cross-threaded.

explanations.correct: 'Might be' correctly expresses technical possibility/deduction without ungrammatical 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Způsobová slovesa vyjadřující možnost (might, may, can, could) se nikdy nepojí s předložkou 'to': 'might be cross-threaded'.

questions.prompt: Never inflate a new air spring assembly beyond 0.5 bar _____ the axle shock absorber and upper retaining bracket are fully bolted down.

explanations.correct: 'Until' indicates a condition or time limit that must occur before the prohibited action can change.
explanations.wrong_A: 'by' denotes a deadline, not a temporal condition clause.
explanations.wrong_C: 'during' cannot introduce a finite subordinate clause.
explanations.wrong_D: 'since' indicates elapsed time from a past event or reason.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Until' = dokud ne / až do okamžiku, kdy. V angličtině po 'until' nenásleduje zápor: 'until they are fully bolted down'.

questions.prompt: The maintenance technician _____ the pneumatic quick-release coupling yesterday because the internal O-ring had dried out.

explanations.correct: The specific past time indicator 'yesterday' strictly requires Past Simple 'replaced'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect 'has replaced' cannot be used with finished past time expressions like 'yesterday'.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Simple expresses habitual routines, not a specific finished event.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Continuous expresses an action in progress right now.

questions.cz_learning_point: S příslovečným určením minulého času jako 'yesterday' se v angličtině striktně pojí minulý čas prostý (Past Simple: 'replaced'), nikoli předpřítomný čas.

questions.prompt: Tatra workshop manual TM-815 specifies that the mounting nuts _____ to 180 Nm using a calibrated torque wrench.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal 'should be tightened' correctly indicates how the nuts must be handled.
explanations.wrong_B: Active 'should tighten' is wrong; nuts cannot tighten themselves.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod se způsobovým slovesem: 'should be tightened' (měly by být dotaženy). Vyhněte se činnému rodu u neživých součástek.

questions.prompt: To verify proper sealing after installation, apply soapy water solution _____ all pneumatic push-in airline fittings.

explanations.correct: The verb 'apply' collocates with preposition 'to': 'apply solution to fittings'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'into' would mean introducing liquid inside the pressurized air lines, which causes contamination.
explanations.wrong_B: 'towards' denotes general direction, not contact application.
explanations.wrong_D: 'on top' is an incomplete prepositional phrase lacking 'of'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'apply something to something' = aplikovat / nanést něco na něco. Do vnitřku vedení ('into') se roztok nesmí dostat.

questions.prompt: The truck cannot pass the workshop functional release inspection _____ the pneumatic leveling valve automatically restores ride height within 30 seconds.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' means 'except if' or 'if not', expressing the mandatory condition required for passing.
explanations.wrong_A: 'provided that' would mean the truck cannot pass IF the valve works, which is illogical.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an inverted, illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' znamená 'pokud ne' (if not). Po 'unless' už v anglické větě nenásleduje další zápor.
